content: Pyrantel is an anti-worm medication that is prescribed to treat infections caused by roundworms, hookworms, pinworms, and other parasitic worms. In some cases, it may be prescribed for other uses. If you have questions about its use, consult your doctor or pharmacist for more information. Pyrantel is available in capsule form and as a liquid to be taken orally. For pinworm and roundworm infections, it is typically administered as a single dose. In the case of pinworm infections, the dose is often repeated after two weeks. For hookworm infections, pyrantel is usually taken once daily for three consecutive days. This medication can be taken with food, juice, or milk, or on an empty stomach. If using the liquid form, shake the bottle well to ensure the medication is evenly mixed. The liquid can also be mixed with milk or fruit juice for easier consumption. Always follow the instructions on your prescription label carefully, and ask your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions. Take pyrantel exactly as directed. Do not take more or less of it, or take it more frequently than prescribed by your doctor. Before taking pyrantel, inform your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to pyrantel or any other medications. Additionally, let them know about all prescription and nonprescription medications you are currently taking, especially piperazine (another anti-worm medication) and any vitamins. Inform your doctor if you have or have ever had anemia or liver disease. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, notify your doctor. If you become pregnant while taking pyrantel, contact your doctor immediately. If you forget to take a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not take a double dose to make up for a missed one. Pyrantel may cause side effects. Notify your doctor if you experience any of the following symptoms, especially if they are severe or persistent: upset stomach, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, stomach cramps, stomach pain, or straining and pain during bowel movements. Store pyrantel in the container it came in, tightly closed, and out of reach of children. Keep it at room temperature, away from excessive heat and moisture (do not store it in the bathroom). Dispose of any expired or no longer needed medication properly. Consult your pharmacist for guidance on the safe disposal of unused medication. Keep all appointments with your doctor and laboratory, as your doctor may order specific lab tests to monitor your response to pyrantel. Do not share your medication with anyone else. Your prescription is likely not refillable. If you continue to experience symptoms of infection after completing the pyrantel treatment, contact your doctor.
